changelog:
- Updated data model guidance for v3.0.1: entity field is now canonically type (was typ); all entities use type.
- Documentation and examples updated to use type instead of typ for entity objects.
- Classification and extraction instructions revised to reference the type field.
- Improved instructions for developer compatibility with the updated field names.
- No changes to core functionality or graph schema—update is for documentation and field alignment only.
summary: A structured knowledge graph acting as a cognitive lens for AI agents. Enables paradox resolution, analysis of open questions, and high-complexity future forecasting based on Beckmann Logic, Predictive Brain Theory, and simulation models.
